from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document sufficient to match it to a specific result."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document, e.g. '《判决文书 1》'")
    primary_party: str | None = Field(description="Name of the appellant or key party (e.g., '高某花', '连某 1')")
    dispute_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case, e.g. '法定继承', '财产损害赔偿'")
    case_fee_amount: float | None = Field(description="Monetary amount explicitly labeled as case fee")
    compensation_amount: float | None = Field(description="Monetary amount for compensation or payment order")
    ruling_action: str | None = Field(description="Core ruling logic, e.g. '驳回上诉，维持原判', '驳回再审申请'")
    criminal_penalty: str | None = Field(description="Criminal sentence or penalty if applicable, e.g. '有期徒刑'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_details: list[CaseInfo]
